data.long_meaning: The name Roscoe originated from the Old English words 'ros' meaning 'dew' and 'cu' meaning 'power, strength'. The name Roscoe is of Anglo-Saxon origin and is a masculine name. It was used to describe someone who was powerful and had the strength of dew, representing the vigor and freshness of new beginnings. The name Roscoe carries the meaning “Famous, powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Roscoe usually hope their child will grow to embody famous, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
